gloss: to do completely; to go and do; to mess up

definitions.gloss: to finish doing; to get done; to go ahead and do
definitions.explanation: やる plus the ～てしまう aspect marker. The neutral reading is completion: 'get the thing done', often with a sense of resolving to do it now rather than later.

definitions.gloss: to mess up; to blow it; to do something one regrets
definitions.explanation: The same form takes on a negative emotional reading depending on context, especially in the past tense (やってしまった): 'I did it (and now I regret it)'. Contracted to やっちゃう / やっちゃった in casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やってしまおう。
⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やってしまいたい。
examples.english: I want to get this work done today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やってしまった⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to get tedious paperwork out of the way early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やってしまった。
examples.english: I got nervous and made the same mistake again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけないこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つい⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧やってしまった。
examples.english: I let something I shouldn't have said slip out.

notes:
⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ + the aspect marker ～てしまう. The two senses share one form but are usually clear from context — present/volitional usually means completion, past usually means regret.

CONTRACTIONS:
- やってしまう → ⟦やっ→やる：02980_yaru⟧ちゃう (casual)
- やってしまった → ⟦やっ→やる：02980_yaru⟧ちゃった (casual, the most common form of sense 2)

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- ⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to finish off; to get over with — focused on completion only, no regret reading
- ～⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to do thoroughly to the end — full completion, no negative nuance
- しまう alone: same aspect marker after other verbs (⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧しまう, ⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまう)
